fullPassage: Human beings have evolved to make the most of the resources available to them in ways that are subtle and complicated. When we change our diets, especially when we do so quickly, we are effectively conducting huge experiments in nutrition. We ought to have more humility. Nutritional science is still young and there is so much we do not know. If we have eaten certain foods in certain ways for millennia, we should assume until it is proven otherwise that there is probably a good reason why. Traditional foods that don't fit neatly on the contemporary dietary food plate should generally be chosen over highly processed ones that do. We should assume that traditionally made fatty blood sausages are preferable to lean, factory-made salamis; that spoonfuls of honey are superior to sprinkles of sweeteners. Witnessing how poorly traditional societies are faring as they undergo a nutrition transition should make those who have already completed it question whether their diets have moved too far.

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어(witness)를 어법에 맞게 변형하여 (1단어) (영어로) (   ) 쓰시오.

det.korean: 문장의 주어 자리(동사는 should make). witness(동사) → Witnessing(동명사: 목격하는 것).
det.analysis: 주어 자리 + 뒤에 목적어(how절) → 동명사. witness → Witnessing (동명사구 주어)

questions.passage: Human beings have evolved to make the most of the resources available to them in ways that are subtle and complicated. When we change our diets, especially when we do so quickly, we are effectively conducting huge experiments in nutrition. We ought to have more humility. Nutritional science is still young and there is so much we do not know. If we have eaten certain foods in certain ways for millennia, we should assume until it is proven otherwise that there is probably a good reason why. Traditional foods that don't fit neatly on the contemporary dietary food plate should generally be chosen over highly processed ones that do. We should assume that traditionally made fatty blood sausages are preferable to lean, factory-made salamis; that spoonfuls of honey are superior to sprinkles of sweeteners. Witnessing how poorly traditional societies are faring as they undergo a nutrition transition should make those who have already completed it question whether their diets have __________.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 영양 전환을 겪는 전통 사회가 형편없이 지내는 것을 보면, 이미 전환을 마친 사람들은 자신의 식단이 너무 멀리 갔는지(moved too far) 의문을 가져야 한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① moved too far: 원문 일치 (question whether their diets have moved too far) ←정답

❌ ② improved greatly(크게 개선되었다): 반대 의미

❌ ③ stayed the same(그대로였다): 문맥 부적절

❌ ④ become cheaper(더 저렴해졌다): 본문 근거 없음
det.tip: move too far = (전통에서) 너무 멀리 벗어나다

det.korean: 전통 사회가 영양 전환을 겪으면서(undergo a nutrition transition) 얼마나 형편없이 지내는지를 목격하는 것.
det.analysis:
❌ ① maintain their old recipes(옛 조리법을 유지하다): 반대 의미 — 유지하면 형편없어질 이유 없음

❌ ② reject modern medicine(현대 의학을 거부하다): 본문 근거 없음

✅ ③ undergo a nutrition transition: 원문 일치 (as they undergo a nutrition transition) ←정답

❌ ④ export traditional foods(전통 음식을 수출하다): 본문 근거 없음
